membrane_render_rgb — DRIVE tacsim op

• Data kinds: normalmap × matrix → rgb

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.membrane_render_rgb(normals, lights, albedo: 'float' = 1.0, ambient: 'float' = 0.03, noise: 'float' = 0.0, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import tacsim; tacsim.membrane_render_rgb(normals, lights, albedo: 'float' = 1.0, ambient: 'float' = 0.03, noise: 'float' = 0.0, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("membrane_render_rgb"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

法線場 (H, W, 3) + 光源 (3, 3) → 視触覚センサ風の RGB (H, W, 3) float。チャネル k = 光源 k の Lambertian 像 albedo·(max(N·L_k, 0) + ambient)(photometric.render_lambertian を 3 回、第 2 実装)。noise > 0 なら正規乱数を足す。

Raises ValueError: normals が (H, W, 3) でない、lights が (3, 3) でない、noise < 0。
